rules: Never the Claude API or an Anthropic SDK (CLAUDE.md).

Live traveller features stay where they are today: Ask on Workers AI, the rest on Gemini Flash-Lite, with the triggers below (owner decision T1138-h, 2026-11-12). When a plan-day or suggest-city trigger is reached, that feature moves to the best open model that passes its eval, and CLAUDE.md and decision 0005 change in the same commit (owner decision T1135-g, 2026-11-12).
A batch job selects the box only after it passes its eval there (pipeline/ai_gateway.py BOX_PASSED).
cost_formula: per 1,000 calls: (input tokens x input price + (output tokens + extra_out_tokens) x output price) / 1,000, in EUR; box: CPU seconds per call = input / (prompt_tok_s x parallel_slots_speedup) + output / (gen_tok_s x parallel_slots_speedup), at the CAX41 hourly price
